\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{lamalunga}
\input{tikz-pbefs}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[tile/.style={cell, minimum width=6mm, minimum height=6mm,
                                 font=\sffamily\small}]
  % (a) the operators of the sliding-tile puzzle: a state generated by the
  % move "down" of the blank does not generate the move "up"
  \node[steplabel, anchor=west] at (-2.4,2.4) {(a) by the operator};
  \node[closed] (p) at (0,1.2) {$p$};
  \node[current] (u) at (0,-0.6) {$u$};
  \node[open] (l) at (-1.9,-2.2) {$v_1$};
  \node[open] (r) at (1.9,-2.2) {$v_2$};
  \node[open] (d) at (0,-2.6) {$v_3$};
  \draw[edge] (p) -- node[cost] {down} (u);
  \draw[edge] (u) -- node[cost] {left} (l);
  \draw[edge] (u) -- node[cost] {right} (r);
  \draw[edge] (u) -- node[cost] {down} (d);
  \draw[edge, pbefsAdded, dashed, bend left=60] (u) to
    node[pos=0.5, fill=white, inner sep=0pt, text=pbefsAdded,
         font=\bfseries\large] {$\times$}
    node[pos=0.5, left=5pt, cost, text=pbefsAdded] {up} (p);
  \node[caption, anchor=west, align=left] at (-2.4,-3.75)
    {$u$ stores op$(u) =$ down; the inverse move, up,\\
     is never generated, so $p$ is not looked up};
  % (b) without operators, the comparison with the state two places back
  \begin{scope}[xshift=7.4cm]
    \node[steplabel, anchor=west] at (-1.6,2.4) {(b) on the path of IDA*};
    \node[listname, anchor=west] at (-1.6,1.2) {path};
    \node[cell, minimum width=8mm] (c0) at (0.3,1.2) {$s_0$};
    \node[cell, minimum width=8mm, right=0pt of c0] (c1) {$\cdots$};
    \node[cell, minimum width=8mm, right=0pt of c1] (c2) {$p$};
    \node[cellhi, minimum width=8mm, right=0pt of c2] (c3) {$u$};
    \node[current] (u2) at (2.75,-0.6) {$u$};
    \node[open] (w1) at (1.0,-2.2) {$w_1$};
    \node[pruned] (w2) at (2.75,-2.6) {$p$};
    \node[open] (w3) at (4.5,-2.2) {$w_2$};
    \draw[edge] (u2) -- (w1);
    \draw[edge, draw=pbefsAdded] (u2) -- (w2);
    \draw[edge] (u2) -- (w3);
    \node[val, text=pbefsAdded, below=2pt of w2]
      {$=$ path$[\,|\mathrm{path}| - 2\,]$};
    \node[caption, anchor=west, align=left] at (-1.6,-4.05)
      {a successor equal to the state before $u$\\
       on the path is skipped};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
